subject: Renewal discussion + pilot scope: Nyx Health — post-call recap & next steps
messages:
From: Emma Liu <emma@nyxhealth.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 15:05:00 -0800
Subject: Follow-up from today — renewal + new workloads

Diego / Monica / Markus,

Thanks again for the call today — good discussion. Quick recap from our side and a few asks so we can evaluate the renewal versus Dedicated/pilot options: 

Key takeaways (Nyx perspective):
- Usage growth: Q4 showed a 15% month-over-month rise in token consumption driven by expanded QA logging and nightly batch embeddings (report attached: nyx-usage-q4.csv).
- New workloads under consideration: 1) PII redaction & content sanitization (low latency requirement for pre-prod validation pipeline); 2) Dense embeddings + semantic search for patient notes (high throughput, cold-start cost concerns).
- Pain points: occasional timeouts on long-context QA jobs (30–45s), unpredictable tail latency during peak hours, and wanting clearer audit logs for compliance reviews.
- Goals for renewal window: keep cost growth under control (+10–15% target), validate a Dedicated or Private pilot for embeddings and redaction workloads, and get an SLA/backstop for tail latency.

Asks / next steps:
1) Please share a rough Dedicated sizing recommendation and a pricing worksheet that includes a 90-day pilot option.
2) Can you describe caching/kv options (prefix/KV caching) and how that would apply to our nightly embedding jobs?
3) Schedule a technical deep dive next week with your infra/eng to walk through the longest running job samples (Jordan will provide logs).

Thanks — I want to make sure we have the right proposal before we start the procurement/redline process.

Emma Liu
Director, Data Platforms
Nyx Health

Attachment: nyx-usage-q4.csv (CSV, 86 KB)
From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
To: Emma Liu <emma@nyxhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 17:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up from today — renewal + new workloads

Emma — thanks for the clear recap and the upload. Quick post-call summary from our side and what we'll deliver by EOD Friday.

Confirmed pain points / goals (Redwood):
- Tail latency and occasional timeouts on long contexts: we saw similar patterns on embedding-heavy workloads; options are Dedicated with latency SLAs + targeted KV/prefix caching for those QA jobs.
- Cost control: we can present a pricing worksheet with a committed term and a pilot-based consumption cap to limit spend during evaluation.
- Compliance/audit needs: our Private offering includes richer audit logs and KMS integration; we can outline what is available in-hosted vs private.

Deliverables (we will send by 2027-01-15 EOD):
1) Sizing recommendation for a Dedicated pool to cover your peak embedding throughput (includes GPU count estimate and expected tokens/sec).
2) redwood-proposed-pricing-v2.pdf — pricing tiers including a 90-day pilot discount and a buyout path; line items for Dedicated vs Private vs hosted overage.
3) pilot-scope.md — suggested plan for a 90-day pilot (milestones, success metrics: latency P95/P99, embedding throughput, cost per 1M tokens).
4) Notes on caching strategies and KV usage tailored to nightly batch flows.

Proposed schedule: technical deep dive with Eng (30–45m) — Wed Jan 20 at 10:00 AM PST. Please confirm and I will send a calendar invite and an agenda (we'll include an infra engineer and our solutions architect).

A few clarifying Qs while we scope sizing: 
- For embeddings: what's the current average vector size and batch size you run overnight? (Jordan, can you paste a sample?).
- For redaction: acceptable P95 latency for pre-prod validation?

If Wed 1/20 doesn't work we can do Tues 1/19 afternoon PST.

Thanks,
Diego Fernandez
Senior Account Executive — Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415 555 0199

Attachments: redwood-proposed-pricing-v2.pdf (PDF, 112 KB); pilot-scope.md (text, 6 KB)
From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Emma Liu <emma@nyxhealth.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 13 Jan 2027 10:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up from today — renewal + new workloads

Emma / Diego — looping to confirm the technical deep dive and to note next internal owners.

Short items: 
- Confirmed deep dive: Wed 20 Jan, 10:00 AM PST — I'll send the calendar invite and include our infra lead (Markus) and Solutions Eng (Priyom Das).
- Jordan (Nyx) — please drop the sample long-run logs (or a sanitized excerpt) into the Drive link below so our engs can pre-read. That will help speed up the sizing convo.
- I'll follow up after the deep dive with a concise mutual action plan (MAP) that maps timelines to procurement milestones for the renewal decision (targeting renewal decision by end of Feb).

Best,
Monica Patel
Account Manager — Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference, Inc.
